墨镜男终于松了口气，好奇问道：“不过是宗师级别的战斗，你还要看？”
女子沉默片刻，道：“那个穷小子有些奇怪，我得再看看。”
墨镜男就将房间视频调了出来，从头开始放。
“停。”女子道。
墨镜男按下暂停键，影像顿时停滞住。
这是最后时刻，顾青山全面动用灵力灌注箭矢的那一瞬间。
“你看，”女子眯起双眼，指着箭矢的位置，“空气是最敏感的，任何力量出现在空气中，空气都会做出反应。”
墨镜男认真望去，只见箭矢的锋头上，两道扭曲的透明波纹若隐若现。
他摇头道：“我从来没见过这种东西，难道是一种未知的超凡？”
“真有意思，这种力量虽然看上去弱小，但给我的感觉很独特，”美丽女子盯着屏幕喃喃道，“我们要想办法接触一下这个穷小子。”
漫长的一夜终于过去。
城南，一处高档住宅小区。
“你不想替你的同伴报仇？”顾青山似笑非笑的望着对方。
王铭摇头道：“我们都是被悬赏任务吸引，临时走到一起的，在这之前并不认识。”
王铭丢过去一串钥匙，道：“你饶过我一命，我唯一能替你做的，就是给你提供这样一个隐秘的休息场所，毕竟聂家势力太过强大。”
顾青山接过钥匙，意外的看了对方一眼，道：“多谢你的好意，那我先走了。”
王铭一呆，连忙问道：“你去哪里？”
“去打工。”
“打工？”王铭一时没反应过来。
“恩，打工赚钱，才有饭吃，再说以后上大学处处都要花钱的。”顾青山道。

除了九府贵族之外，联邦每个公民都处于公正女神的监控下。
自己重生而来，万一在行为上贸然出现太大的变化，一定会引起不必要的注意。
所以短时间内，最好还是保持原先的生活轨迹，一切照旧。
毕竟，这就是顾青山少年时，原本的生活状态。
王铭怀疑自己是不是耳朵出问题，听错了对方的话。
眼前这少年，一口气能干掉五个杀手，就连武道宗师都被他设计的死死的，从22楼掉下去摔成一团烂泥。
——这样的人物，居然要靠打工赚钱来维持生计？
王铭觉得不可思议，但也没多事的追问。
他本就是杀手，知道每个人都有每个人的秘密。
“钥匙我收下，”顾青山收下钥匙，说道：“给你个忠告吧，现在就逃出长宁郡，一路往东，直到进入伏羲帝国。”
“为什么？”王铭道。
“昨晚的事必定已经曝光，我这边挂靠的有苏家的相应单位，聂家一次没成功，不会在没有把握的情况下再次动我，但你不同，你是见不得光的杀手，不走的话随时会死。”
顾青山又道：“你这样的人更适合交朋友做生意，并不适合杀手这个冷血职业，你留在这里，就算不被聂家弄死，也会在未来某一天被人杀掉。”
他忽然笑道：“也幸好今天这些事，聂云根本不敢捅出去，不然公正女神首先要对付的，就是他。”
王铭默默点头，道：“那我走了，日后有缘再见。”
决断干脆，没有半点拖泥带水，这人的魄力倒是不错。
顾青山赞赏的点点头，离开了房间。
半小时后，他来到一座高耸入云的科技大楼。
熟练的刷卡，进入大楼，再次刷卡，进入地下建筑。
经过虹膜认证和指纹认证，又换上了一身工作服，这才领了工牌，进入电梯，直通地下50层。

电梯门“长宁钢铁战甲研发部欢迎你，编号41157。”
顾青山大步朝里走去。
他的对面，是好几台5米高的钢铁机甲，许多身穿工作服的人正围着机甲忙碌着，讨论着。
这里是长宁府最大的机甲研发中心，是长宁苏家的核心产业，就算是苏家的子弟，若是没有这方面的扎实能力，同样不会被允许进入。
顾青山望着那几台冰冷的战斗机器，心中渐渐浮现出一丝兴奋感。
这是人类文明的产物，是无数前沿学科交汇所诞生的科技结晶，代表了这个世界最强大的战斗力量。
飞梭什么的，在钢铁铸就的战争机甲面前，简直是弱爆了。
这种梦幻般的冰冷机械，对每一个男人都有着致命的吸引力。

content_en:
The man in sunglasses finally breathed a sigh of relief and asked curiously: "It's just a grandmaster-level battle, you still want to watch it?"
The woman was silent for a moment and said, "That poor boy is a little strange. I have to take another look."
The man in sunglasses pulled up the room video and played it from the beginning.
"Stop," the woman said.
The man in sunglasses pressed the pause button, and the image suddenly stopped.
This is the last moment, the moment when Gu Qingshan fully uses his spiritual power to infuse the arrow.
"Look," the woman narrowed her eyes and pointed to the location of the arrow, "air is the most sensitive. If any force appears in the air, the air will react."
The man in sunglasses looked carefully and saw two twisted transparent ripples looming on the tip of the arrow.
He shook his head and said: "I have never seen such a thing before. Could it be an unknown extraordinary thing?"
"It's really interesting. Although this kind of power looks weak, it gives me a very unique feeling," the beautiful woman murmured while staring at the screen, "We have to find a way to get in touch with this poor boy."
The long night is finally over.
In the south of the city, there is a high-end residential area.
"You don't want to avenge your companions?" Gu Qingshan looked at the other party with a half-smile.
Wang Ming shook his head and said: "We were attracted by the bounty mission and came together temporarily. We didn't know each other before."
Wang Ming threw a bunch of keys and said, "If you spare my life, the only thing I can do for you is to provide you with such a private resting place. After all, the Nie family is too powerful."
Gu Qingshan took the key, glanced at the other party unexpectedly, and said: "Thank you for your kindness, I'll leave first."
Wang Ming was stunned and quickly asked: "Where are you going?"
"Go to work."
"Working?" Wang Ming didn't react for a while.
"Well, you have to work to earn money so you can have food. Besides, going to college will cost money everywhere in the future." Gu Qingshan said.
Except for the nobles of the Nine Palaces, every citizen of the Federation is under the supervision of the Goddess of Justice.
Since he was reborn, if he suddenly changes his behavior too much, he will definitely attract unnecessary attention.
Therefore, in the short term, it is best to maintain the original life trajectory and keep everything as usual.
After all, this was Gu Qingshan's original living situation when he was a boy.
Wang Ming wondered if there was something wrong with his ears and he misheard what the other party said.
The young man in front of him could kill five killers in one breath. Even the martial arts master was designed by him to fall from the 22nd floor and fall into a ball of mud.
——Such a character actually relies on working to earn money to make a living?
Wang Ming found it incredible, but he didn't ask any more questions.
He is a killer and knows that everyone has everyone's secrets.
"I'll accept the key," Gu Qingshan accepted the key and said, "I'll give you a piece of advice. Escape from Changning County now and go east until you enter the Fuxi Empire."
"Why?" Wang Ming asked.
"What happened last night must have been exposed. I am affiliated with the corresponding unit of the Su family. The Nie family failed once and will not touch me again without being sure. But you are different. You are a shady killer. If you don't leave, you will die at any time."
Gu Qingshan added: "People like you are more suitable for making friends and doing business, and are not suitable for the cold-blooded profession of killer. If you stay here, even if you are not killed by the Nie family, you will be killed one day in the future."
He suddenly smiled and said: "Fortunately, Nie Yun didn't dare to expose these things today, otherwise the first person the goddess of justice would have to deal with would be him."
Wang Ming nodded silently and said, "Then I'll go and see you again in the future."
The decision was straightforward, without any sloppiness. This man's courage was quite good.
Gu Qingshan nodded appreciatively and left the room.
Half an hour later, he came to a towering technology building.
Swipe the card skillfully to enter the building, swipe the card again and enter the underground building.
After iris authentication and fingerprint authentication, I changed into a new suit.After getting his work uniform, he received his work permit and entered the elevator, which went directly to the 50th floor underground.
Elevator door "Changning Steel Armor R&D Department welcomes you, number 41157."
Gu Qingshan strode inside.
Opposite him were several 5-meter-tall steel mechas. Many people in work clothes were busy discussing around the mechas.
This is the largest mecha research and development center in Changning Prefecture, and it is the core industry of the Su family in Changning. Even the children of the Su family will not be allowed to enter if they do not have solid abilities in this area.
Gu Qingshan looked at the cold fighting machines, and a sense of excitement gradually emerged in his heart.
This is the product of human civilization, the crystallization of science and technology born from the intersection of countless cutting-edge disciplines, and represents the most powerful fighting force in the world.
Shuttles and other such things are simply weak in front of war mechas made of steel.
This dreamlike cold machine has a fatal attraction for every man.
